paragraphs.text: Slinza , also known as the Spiked Stampede , is a legendary beast from an unknown plane.

Slinza is a character who debuted in Foundations Jumpstart as part of the Green Beasts deck . It is a large, muscular, four-legged creature with green skin and brown spikes sticking out of its skin. It also has two large horns on the side of its head. Slinza empowers other beasts by decreasing their mana cost and having them gain an additional +1/+1 counter as they enter. The Stampede portion of its epithet is represented by it being able to fight other creatures when those of a power 4 or greater enter.
